lines: Baatein hain, na muflis hi, na daulat wale
couplets.en: Poverty and wealth are only words.

lines: Pee kar jo maza lete hain qismat wale
couplets.en: Fortunate are those who can savor the wine.

lines: Jo hosh ki daldal mein hain, woh kya jaanein?
couplets.en: What would they know, mired in sobriety?

lines: Is paar se kis paar gaye matwale?
couplets.en: To what shore have the revelers crossed?

lines: Duniya hai hawa, saara bharam hai, saaqi
couplets.en: The world is air, all of it an illusion, cupbearer.

lines: Ik aag hai, yeh umr alam hai, saaqi
couplets.en: Life burns with sorrow, cupbearer.

lines: Paani ki tarah paak hain, lekin
couplets.en: And yet, we are as pure as water.

lines: Ik din mil jaayenge mitti mein, yeh gham hai, saaqi
couplets.en: Our sorrow, cupbearer, is that one day we will return to dust.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Yeh chaandni ka dukh hai, magar tu samet le
couplets.en: The grief is the moonlight's, but gather it all the same.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Raaton ko toot-te hue taaron ka gham na kar
couplets.en: Do not grieve for the stars that fall at night.

lines: Palkon pe uski yaad ke jugnu, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the fireflies of that memory from your lashes.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Sab jagmagate khwaab fizaaon mein uchhaal de
couplets.en: Toss every shimmering dream into the open air.

lines: Sooraj ke ehtiraam mein pehlu, samet le
couplets.en: Draw yourself in, in deference to the sun.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Kaali ghata ko khul ke barasna naseeb ho
couplets.en: May the dark clouds have their fill of rain.

lines: Ya Rab, zameen ki pyaas, agar tu samet le
couplets.en: Lord, if only you would gather up the earth's thirst.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Yeh chaandni ka dukh hai, magar tu samet le
couplets.en: The grief is the moonlight's, but gather it all the same.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.
